digest.component_or_area: differ mutation filtering at production snapshot call site
propositions: The raw differ emits documented field-drift positive control mutations while the production snapshot call site filters them to zero outbound updates.
Genuine inbound-create and invariant-seed mutations survive the post-differ filter.
A converged pass records mutation_count == 0 after filtering.
The call-site filter records exactly zero per-mutation git rev-parse calls on empty batches.
